features.description: Add explicit fallback_models chain schema, bounded policy constants, exact failure classification, and fail-closed startup validation for registry identity, harness, duplicates, length, and price ratio
acceptance_criteria: model A plus fallback_models B resolves exactly [A,B], while pinned agents without tails remain [A] and do not inherit role chains
unresolvable, cross-harness, duplicate, over-length, pin-repeating, and greater-than-3x-price tails prevent startup with actionable errors
exact September idle and killed errors classify transport while hard timeout, git, auth, and scope failures remain terminal

features.description: Transport the validated chain to Cloud Run and implement a fresh-worktree, single-owner execution loop that walks at most once only for transport failures
acceptance_criteria: a deterministic 503 on A followed by success on B invokes exactly two models inside one execution without incrementing task AttemptCount
git, auth, scope, hard-timeout, and unknown failures invoke only the pinned model
the loop enforces MaxInContainerWalks=1, failed partial work is absent from the next attempt, and stale-task detector behavior is unchanged

features.description: Add per-attempt completion provenance, cumulative cost accounting, serving-model attribution, completion-handler banking, inbox visibility, and structured walk logs
acceptance_criteria: all completion paths carry deterministic ModelUsed and ChainLinkIndex attribution
a walked completion exposes both attempts with model, link, failure class, bounded error, duration, and cost while total cost includes both runs
banked results and inbox notifications name the terminal model, and walked failures narrate both links and the first classification

features.description: Add fleet-safe compatibility coverage and operator documentation, run deterministic outage scenarios and repository-wide verification without configuring live-agent fallbacks
acceptance_criteria: documentation states fallback is opt-in, bounded, cost-changing, same-harness only, and observable in completion attempt history
the shipped registry gains no fallback declarations and agents without the field retain unchanged behavior
deterministic walk and terminal scenarios pass along with make test, make lint, and make check-boundaries
